caption: The drawing depicts a single goblet with a wide, gently flaring bowl and a short stem attached to a round base. The exterior of the goblet is colored in a muted reddish-orange tone. Around the bowl of the goblet, there is a decorative motif of green leaves and a central yellow and brown flower with red accents and small blue details. The interior of the goblet is shaded with a light yellowish-beige color. The base of the goblet consists of three concentric rings in different colors: the topmost part is reddish-orange like the stem, followed by a green ring beneath that, and the bottommost ring is black. The background of the drawing is plain and unadorned, with a light beige color.
title: Pa. German Salt Cup
